articles.title: Monkeys May Share Our Instinct for Geometry, Study Finds
articles.summary: A new study shows monkeys and humans make similar mistakes when matching shapes, suggesting we're not the only species with a head for geometry. One baboon named Kalamata plays math games for hours.

articles.title: U.S. Just Had Its Hottest Summer in 132 Years, NOAA Reports
articles.summary: The summer of 2026 was the hottest in the U.S. in at least 132 years, with temperatures 3°F above average. More than half the country was in drought by September, and wildfires burned across several states.

articles.title: Survey Reveals Physicists Disagree on Universe's Biggest Mysteries
articles.summary: The largest-ever survey of physicists found little agreement on dark matter, quantum gravity, and even the Big Bang. Only two questions won majority support, but scientists say the disagreement signals opportunity.
